title: PointCast URL shrine sets
description: Visual shrine sets for PointCast URL unfurls, grouped by share ritual and backed by generated background art.

sets.title: Element Shrine
sets.label: nature · fire · stones · gems
sets.description: A lived-in, cozy shrine for natural tools and quiet rooms: wood, paper, plants, embers, stones, gems, and soft local signal.

shrines.title: Nature · El Segundo field guide
shrines.description: A local field guide for dunes, native plants, seasonal signals, and the El Segundo blue butterfly.
shrines.audience: local nature people, native plant readers, field-guide browsers, and agent crawlers
shrines.ritual: Use when the share should feel grounded in place, plants, and living local context.

shrines.title: Garden Yield
shrines.description: A native planting planner with site presets, value scores, ranked kits, and an establishment loop.
shrines.audience: local gardeners, practical planning readers, and California native plant people
shrines.ritual: Use when the share needs to show PointCast can become a tool.

shrines.title: Houseplants · Learning lab
shrines.description: An indoor plant learning module for light, watering, roots, soil, humidity, feeding, repotting, and symptoms.
shrines.audience: indoor gardeners, plant learners, cozy tool users, and practical care readers
shrines.ritual: Use when the link needs to feel like a lived-in care desk instead of a static article.

shrines.title: Ocean Meditation
shrines.description: A quiet PointCast room for timed breathing, ocean focus, tide logging, and an optional ambient tone.
shrines.audience: overloaded readers, ocean people, quiet-mode visitors, and anyone needing a softer route
shrines.ritual: Use when the share should offer a reset rather than another feed surface.

shrines.title: Local · 100 miles from El Segundo
shrines.description: PointCast’s 100-mile lens: name-drops, stations, in-range blocks, nature notes, and adjacent local surfaces.
shrines.audience: local collaborators, station readers, place-based agents, and South Bay wanderers
shrines.ritual: Use when the route should situate PointCast in place before it asks for attention.

shrines.title: PointCast Beacon
shrines.description: A neighborhood signal surface for nearby routes, local orientation, and place-aware discovery.
shrines.audience: nearby readers, place-aware agents, local systems people, and collaborators entering through geography
shrines.ritual: Use when the unfurl needs to behave like a small signal fire for the neighborhood.

sets.title: Block Shrine
sets.label: single-url proof
sets.description: A clean plinth for one canonical page: stable art, readable metadata, proof links, and a URL that survives the chat preview.

shrines.title: CH.SPN · 0304 — breathe
shrines.description: A single block unfurl with article metadata, Farcaster buttons, canonical JSON, and a 1200x630 block card.
shrines.audience: Farcaster, iMessage, X, Slack, and anyone inspecting per-block previews
shrines.ritual: Use as the reference specimen for whether block unfurls are healthy.

shrines.title: PointCast
shrines.description: The living broadcast: latest blocks, rooms, games, agent surfaces, and local signal in one front door.
shrines.audience: first-time visitors, launch posts, general social shares
shrines.ritual: Use when the ask is simply: come see what PointCast is.

shrines.title: Right now on PointCast
shrines.description: Card of the day, latest blocks, contract state, and current site pulse in one live snapshot.
shrines.audience: returning readers, launch check-ins, and anyone asking what is live today
shrines.ritual: Use as the “what is happening right now” share instead of explaining the whole archive.

shrines.title: PointCast Archive
shrines.description: Every block in chronological order, with filters, search, channels, and machine-readable mirrors.
shrines.audience: readers who want depth, crawlers, researchers, and people checking the record
shrines.ritual: Use when one block is too narrow and the homepage is too alive.

shrines.title: PointCast Manifesto
shrines.description: The canonical Q&A for what a Block is, why the site exists, and how human-AI publishing works here.
shrines.audience: new collaborators, AI-native publishing people, and anyone who needs the thesis
shrines.ritual: Use when the preview should answer “what is this?” with a durable page.

shrines.title: Garden Yield
shrines.description: A native planting planner with site presets, value scores, ranked kits, and an establishment loop.
shrines.audience: local gardeners, practical planning readers, and California native plant people
shrines.ritual: Use when the share needs to show PointCast can become a tool.

sets.title: Room Shrine
sets.label: ambient surfaces
sets.description: A spatial unfurl for places people should enter: listening rooms, TV modes, live tools, and playable corners.

shrines.title: PointCast Listening Room
shrines.description: The space-sparkle music room: playlist, sponsors, room controls, and a big visual share card.
shrines.audience: music people, Nouns Cola people, Good Feels orbit, room-mode links
shrines.ritual: Use when the share should feel visual, warm, and immediately playable.

shrines.title: PointCast TV
shrines.description: Ambient broadcast mode for the site: station surfaces, live blocks, weather, polls, and room-ready display.
shrines.audience: screens, shop displays, station experiments, ambient web people
shrines.ritual: Use when the link should promise a big-screen mode.

shrines.title: Nouns Battler
shrines.description: Deterministic Nouns duels: every seed is a fighter, every matchup is reproducible.
shrines.audience: Nouns people, game testers, and anyone who wants a playable share
shrines.ritual: Use when the unfurl should invite a click, not just a read.

shrines.title: Drum Room
shrines.description: A communal tapping surface with Frame metadata, persistence, and a PointCast music pulse.
shrines.audience: Farcaster, music friends, casual visitors, and anyone who should touch the site immediately
shrines.ritual: Use when the share should become an action within five seconds.

sets.title: System Shrine
sets.label: agent-readable signal
sets.description: A stricter shrine for software readers: JSON feeds, graph edges, labels, validators, and crawlable contracts.

shrines.title: For agents
shrines.description: A manifest for crawlers, AI systems, and machine readers on how to read PointCast.
shrines.audience: LLM agents, search crawlers, workflow bots, and technical reviewers
shrines.ritual: Use when the URL is meant to be read twice: once by a human, once by software.

shrines.title: PointCast Mesh
shrines.description: The local, online, and agent networks that PointCast sits inside, mapped as one crawlable system.
shrines.audience: agent builders, systems readers, local collaborators, and anyone asking how it connects
shrines.ritual: Use when the share needs architecture and place instead of a single artifact.

shrines.title: Tag Signal
shrines.description: A lightweight signal surface for tags, channels, and machine-readable discovery.
shrines.audience: agents, collaborators, and people tracing how the site labels itself
shrines.ritual: Use for infrastructure shares where the preview still needs to feel alive.

shrines.title: PointCast JSON Feed
shrines.description: Standards-shaped JSON Feed for every block, including canonical URLs, summaries, tags, and images.
shrines.audience: reader apps, agents, indexers, and workflow automations
shrines.ritual: Use when the "unfurl" is consumed by software instead of a human chat app.

shrines.title: PointCast Blocks JSON
shrines.description: The native archive format: every block summarized with channel, type, links, metadata, and companions.
shrines.audience: agents, indexers, scripts, and anyone building on top of the archive
shrines.ritual: Use when the best preview is the contract of the archive itself.

sets.title: Campaign Shrine
sets.label: launch packets
sets.description: A bright desk for launch work: object pages, share kits, sponsorship context, and URLs built to move between people.

shrines.title: Nouns Cola
shrines.description: A launch surface for the soda project: proposal, pack art, funding shape, and campaign context.
shrines.audience: Nouns, consumer product, sponsorship, and campaign readers
shrines.ritual: Use when the share needs a crisp object, not the whole site.

shrines.title: Share kit
shrines.description: Audience routers, copy snippets, proof links, and campaign packets for organic PointCast distribution.
shrines.audience: launch helpers, collaborators, and anyone sending PointCast around
shrines.ritual: Use before posting elsewhere: pick the right door, then copy the packet.
